nodes.title: SG-5.6 · Admin round endpoints are provably mounted behind the admin token
nodes.body:
Context: server.New registers admin round routes from adminRoundRoutes under /api/v1/admin behind admin.Middleware. TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted only asserts status != 404, which is weak. Desired behavior: unit tests assert the exact status each mounted round endpoint returns with the admin token. Expected result: a missing mount or a broken handler mapping fails a test. Why: SG-5.6 requires proof that the endpoints are mounted when called with the admin token.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a server with admin token tok and an on-disk round, when GET /api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001?world=the-boys-room is sent with Bearer tok, then the response is 200 with the round JSON
- Given the same server, when GET /api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-9999999?world=the-boys-room is sent with Bearer tok, then the response is 404 from the handler
- Given the same server, when POST /api/v1/admin/rounds is sent with Bearer tok and an invalid JSON body, then the response is 400


## Scope
- In scope: Exact-status mount tests in backend/internal/server/server_test.go
- In scope: Exact-status handler tests in backend/internal/admin/rounds_test.go
- Out of scope: New endpoints
- Out of scope: Frontend, worker and game changes
- Preserve: adminRoundRoutes table
- Preserve: admin.Middleware behavior
- Preserve: Existing passing tests


## Technical constraints
- Go tests with httptest and a temp dir only
- No real Git, network or live ports


## Definition of done
- Both new test groups pass
- go test ./internal/server ./internal/admin passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Mounted admin round routes answer with exact handler statuses for a Bearer admin token
nodes.body:
Context: adminRoundRoutes is mounted by New behind admin.Middleware. Desired behavior: with Authorization Bearer tok, GET round answers 200, an unknown round answers 404, and POST /rounds with invalid JSON answers 400. Expected result: tests fail if a route is unmounted or middleware swallows the request. Why: != 404 does not prove the handler ran.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a server with an on-disk round-0000001, when GET /api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001?world=the-boys-room has Bearer tok, then status is 200 and body id is ROUND-0000001
- Given an unknown round id, when GET with Bearer tok, then status is 404 with body not equal to the chi default 404 page
- Given invalid JSON, when POST /api/v1/admin/rounds has Bearer tok, then status is 400 with body invalid json


## Scope
- In scope: backend/internal/server/server.go route table
- Out of scope: Opening or closing rounds through real Git
- Preserve: adminRoutes ordering
- Preserve: Middleware token check


## Technical constraints
- Reuse adminRoundRoutes; do not add routes


## Definition of done
- Routes confirmed mounted exactly as in adminRoundRoutes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Admin round handlers map service results and errors to exact statuses and JSON
nodes.body:
Context: RoundHandler.Get, Open, Close map errors via statusFor. Desired behavior: each endpoint's success and sentinel-error statuses are asserted with fakes. Expected result: handler mapping regressions fail a test. Why: handlers must behave correctly once mounted.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a fakeRounds returning a round, when GET /rounds/{id} is called, then 200 with the round JSON
- Given a fakeRounds returning ErrNotFound, when GET /rounds/{id} is called, then 404
- Given a fakeRounds returning ErrNotFound wrapped, when POST /rounds/{id}/open is called, then 404


## Scope
- In scope: backend/internal/admin/rounds.go
- Out of scope: Service logic
- Preserve: statusFor mapping


## Technical constraints
- Use existing fakes


## Definition of done
- Handler statuses confirmed


## Clarifying questions
- None
